messages:
Ben (Partnerships): HelioSync wants to run a co-sell pilot for SmartAssist. Scope: SSO (SAML), EU-only residency for data, egress whitelist to their analytics endpoint, and a 4-week dedicated pilot. Can we assign technical presales owners?
Tom (Partner Eng): I can own the runbook + arch. Need SAML metadata (they already sent), exact attribute names for tenant mapping, and the IP ranges they expect us to whitelist. Also confirm Dedicated vs Hosted with private networking.
HelioSync - PM: We prefer Dedicated in EU for SLA and residency. SAML metadata: https://heliosync.example.com/saml/metadata.xml. tenant claim name is urn:heliosync:claims:tenant_id.
Nisha (Sales Eng): For budget planning: ballpark cost for 4 weeks on an 8xA100 equivalent dedicated slot? Need a quick estimate to include in the partner proposal.
Aisha (Solutions): We should have a one-page partner runbook: test tenant creation, sample API call, how key rotation works, and telemetry retention notes. Can someone draft and share a link?
Tom (Partner Eng): Draft runbook snippet below. Will expand to one-pager and upload.
```
# create test key (partner workspace)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" -d '{"description":"heliosync-demo"}'
# sample generate
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"redwood-3.8b","prompt":"Summarize"}'
```
Ben (Partnerships): @Ruth they require SOC2 Type II evidence and a 30-day max retention for logs during the pilot. Can Security confirm what artifacts and retention controls we can commit to for a short pilot?
Ruth (Security): We can provide SOC2 Type II summary and a contact for the auditor. For retention, on Dedicated we can configure telemetry to 30 days; I'll add required controls to the kickoff agenda. EU-only routing requires Dedicated in our EU region + VPC/private deployment.
HelioSync - PM: For logs, our security prefers push to our collector. Would a webhook with mTLS work, or do you need cross-account S3?
Tom (Partner Eng): Webhook push with mTLS is our preferred fast path. Cross-account S3 would need an IAM role and a PO; that will add lead time.
Nisha (Sales Eng): Preliminary pricing: ~$65k for the 4-week committed 8xA100-equivalent slot. I'll enter a preliminary quote in SFDC and mark as tentative. SalesOps, want us to firm that up?
Aisha (Solutions): I'll prepare the one-pager and include FAQ about telemetry, token rotation, and how to validate SAML attributes.
Tom (Partner Eng): Kickoff checklist to cover on Wed:
- Confirm SAML attribute mapping (email, tenant_id)
- Confirm egress IP ranges & analytics endpoint
- EU residency toggle and Dedicated activation process
- Decide logs delivery mechanism (webhook+mTLS vs cross-account S3)
- NDA/PO for cross-account S3 if needed
Ben (Partnerships): Scheduling a 30-min kickoff Wed 10am PT with HelioSync infra + security, Tom, Ruth, and Nisha. Please add any pre-read links.
HelioSync - PM: Wed 10am PT confirmed. We'll have infra lead and security reviewer there.
Ruth (Security): I'll upload SOC2 summary to our secure share and add in the calendar invite.
Tom (Partner Eng): Action items: I'll publish the runbook draft by EOD tomorrow, request explicit SAML attribute mapping (they gave mapping for tenant_id), and open a security ticket for cross-account S3 if they insist.
Ben (Partnerships): Great progress. I'll keep this thread updated and share the invite with the runbook link once uploaded. :thumbsup:
HelioSync - PM: Thanks team, looking forward to kickoff.
